svg.title: Pundoku — D5 foreground layers for Icon Composer
svg.desc: Production layers. Flat, opaque, full white, transparent background, no platform mask, no baked effects (app-icons.md › Visual effects). Two groups to split into two layers: #field at ~88 % opacity, #cell at 100 % and tinted with the ink colour inside Icon Composer. Background gradient defined in Icon Composer (see pd98-logo-round3.md § layers).
